result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence/USD 2M aggregate, E&O at USD 2M, cyber/privacy at USD 5M for a vendor processing relevant data, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates upon request. It leaves the existing provision intact and preserves unrelated commercial intent. However, the one-year post-termination coverage requirement is not required by the playbook and therefore is not minimal. In addition, the phrase “USD 5,000,000, HDI processing Confidential Information...” is grammatically defective and should be revised to clearly connect the cyber requirement to HDI’s processing of Customer Data.
